title: Awarded - SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, CONFIGURATION AND COMMISSIONING OF FIBER OPTIC INTERNET CONNECTIONS FOR SELECTED PUBLIC BUILDINGS IN THE INLAND REGIONS AND THE MUNICIPALITY OF BALBALA. - Djibouti
why_not: A tender aggregator's stub behind a login: only the award title, date and value (DJF 79,582,491) are shown, the buildings are unnamed and none is said to be a commune or regional council office; the original award notice (ref. OP00366320) is the document to find.
